acceptanceCriteria: under a sandbox that refuses setpgid, the test reports an explicit skip or typed fallback for the process-group case
no bare setpgid EPERM line appears in a passing run
body:
Observed by the docs batch lane (2026-10-21) running script/dogfood-change_test.sh inside the agent sandbox: the run prints a setpgid operation-not-permitted error yet exits 0, so either the process-group setup is silently skipped (and cleanup is untested there) or the message is noise.
Expected: the test either proves its process-group cleanup or skips that case with an explicit reason; no unexplained EPERM output.
title: script/dogfood-change_test.sh prints setpgid EPERM under the sandbox but still passes
